zh-CN.title: SmartFit
zh-CN.shortDescription: 描述训练场景，按本地模板安排计划，跟随动作示范、计时和语音练习。
zh-CN.fullDescription:
把训练想法变成可以跟练的计划。

SmartFit 提供对话式训练首页、动作浏览、本地模板计划和训练播放器。描述训练场景、器械和时间，使用已有规则与模板安排计划，再进入动作示范、计时和语音跟练。完成后可查看本机训练记录，并保存计划以便再次使用。

当前功能
• 在原有对话界面完成安全确认和训练条件选择。
• 浏览动作说明与可用的内置示范。
• 按本地模板安排训练并保存计划。
• 使用跟练计时、语音和提示音。
• 查看训练结果，调整外观和音频设置。

此上传候选未配置联网 AI 密钥，原有 AI 入口和设置仍然可见；不能在本版本中使用的联网路径保持原状，商店描述不将其宣传为已提供的在线智能服务。可用训练路径以本地规则、模板和实际内置素材为准。部分动作没有内置视频，计时和语音也不代表动作识别或姿势评估。

无需注册账号，无广告。对话、计划、训练结果、设置和设备 UUID 在本机保存；系统备份或设备迁移可按设备和用户设置处理应用数据，不能理解为所有数据永不离开设备。详见隐私政策。

SmartFit 用于一般健身与拉伸示范，不是医疗器械，不诊断、治疗、治愈或预防疾病。存在伤病或其他运动风险时请先咨询医生；训练中如有疼痛、头晕、胸闷等不适，请停止练习并按需就医。肌肉高亮仅为教学示意。

当前界面及语音主要为简体中文。隐私与支持：mhgd3250905@gmail.com

en-US.title: SmartFit
en-US.shortDescription: Plan with local templates, then follow exercise demos, timing, and voice cues.
en-US.fullDescription:
Turn a workout idea into a plan you can follow.

SmartFit retains its conversational training home, exercise library, local planning rules and templates, and guided workout player. Choose your training conditions, use a local template plan, and follow available built-in demonstrations, timing, voice guidance, and chimes. Save plans and view completed workout records on your device.

Current features
• Complete the safety check and choose workout conditions in the original conversation interface.
• Browse exercise instructions and available built-in demonstrations.
• Build and save plans using local templates.
• Follow workout timing, spoken guidance, and chimes.
• View results and adjust appearance and audio preferences.

This upload candidate has no online AI key. The existing AI entrances and settings remain visible, and unavailable online paths have not been redesigned. This listing does not promise a working online AI service. Available training follows the local rules, templates, and bundled media. Not every exercise has a built-in video; timing and audio do not provide movement recognition or posture assessment.

No account is required and the app has no ads. Conversations, plans, results, preferences, and a device UUID are stored locally. Operating-system backup or device transfer may process app data according to the device and user settings; this is not a promise that all data always stays on the device. See the privacy policy.

SmartFit is for general fitness and stretching demonstrations. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent medical conditions. Consult a qualified professional if you have exercise-related risks. Stop and seek appropriate help if you experience pain, dizziness, chest discomfort, or other concerning symptoms. Muscle highlights are educational illustrations.

The interface and voice guidance are primarily in Simplified Chinese. Privacy and support: mhgd3250905@gmail.com
